events.reason: conditor upgrade --check refused (exit 131): 'Conditor lock is missing: .conditor/lock.json. Run conditor init first.' The repository was never Conditor-initialized; adopting a lock (conditor init) needs an owner decision. Also, Aegis 2.0.0 has a known FSharp.Core 11.0.101 floor defect; the target will be Aegis 2.0.1.
Superseded by WI-0002: the owner authorized conditor init (2026-11-25), and WI-0002 adopts the Conditor lock and moves to echelon-current 1.42.0, which selects Aegis 2.0.2
